```{python}
# | label: simulate-processes

import pprint

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objs as go
from scipy.stats import gaussian_kde

from inf_bp_texts.inference import fit_birth_death_process
from inf_bp_texts.simulation import simulate_birth_death_process

# Parameters for simulation
num_sims = 100
birth_rate = 0.005
death_rate = birth_rate - 0.004
time_span = 1500
seed = 42

simulated_processes = []
for i in range(num_sims):
    sim = simulate_birth_death_process(
        birth_rate=birth_rate,
        death_rate=death_rate,
        max_time=time_span,
        random_seed=seed + i,  # ensure different random streams
    )
    simulated_processes.append(sim)

print(simulated_processes[0].head())
print(simulated_processes[1].head())
print(simulated_processes[2].head())
print(simulated_processes[3].head())
print(simulated_processes[4].head())
print(simulated_processes[0].shape)

pprint.pp(simulated_processes[0]["age"].values[0:10])
pprint.pp(simulated_processes[1]["age"].values[0:10])
pprint.pp(simulated_processes[2]["age"].values[0:10])
pprint.pp(simulated_processes[3]["age"].values[0:10])


for sim in simulated_processes:
    print(sim.head())
    print(sim["age"].values)
    break
```

Derivative of the log-likehoods

\begin{equation}
    \frac{dlP_n}{d\lambda} = \frac{\mu  \left(\mu -\mu  n+\lambda  (n-\mu  t+1)+\lambda ^2 t\right)+e^{t (\lambda -\mu )} (n (\lambda -\mu ) (\lambda  t (\lambda -\mu )-\mu )-\mu  (3 \lambda +\mu ))+\lambda  e^{2 t (\lambda -\mu )} (2 \mu +\lambda  t (\mu -\lambda ))}{\lambda  (\lambda -\mu ) \left(e^{t (\lambda -\mu )}-1\right) \left(\lambda  e^{t (\lambda -\mu )}-\mu \right)}
\end{equation}

\begin{equation}
    \frac{dlP_n}{d\mu} = \frac{\lambda ^2 t e^{t (\lambda -\mu )} \left(e^{t (\lambda -\mu )}-n\right)-\lambda  \left(-(2 \mu  n t+n+3) e^{t (\lambda -\mu )}+n+(\mu  t+2) e^{2 t (\lambda -\mu )}+\mu  t+1\right)-\mu  \left((\mu  n t+n-1) e^{t (\lambda -\mu )}-n-\mu  t+1\right)}{(\lambda -\mu ) \left(e^{t (\lambda -\mu )}-1\right) \left(\lambda  e^{t (\lambda -\mu )}-\mu \right)}
\end{equation}

Derivation of the derivative of the ages

\begin{equation}
    \frac{dlP(age)}{d\lambda} = \frac{(\lambda  t-1) e^{\mu  t+T (\lambda -\mu )}-(\lambda  t+\lambda  T-1) e^{\mu  t+2 T (\lambda -\mu )}-\mu  T e^{\lambda  t}+2 \mu  T e^{\lambda  t+T (\lambda -\mu )}}{\left(e^{T (\lambda -\mu )}-1\right) \left(\lambda  e^{\mu  t+T (\lambda -\mu )}-\mu  e^{\lambda  t}\right)}
\end{equation}

\begin{equation}
    \frac{dlP(age)}{d\mu} = \frac{\lambda  T e^{\mu  t+2 T (\lambda -\mu )}+e^{\lambda  t} (\mu  (-t)+\mu  T+1)+(\mu  t-2 \mu  T-1) e^{\lambda  t+T (\lambda -\mu )}}{\left(e^{T (\lambda -\mu )}-1\right) \left(\lambda  e^{\mu  t+T (\lambda -\mu )}-\mu  e^{\lambda  t}\right)}
\end{equation}

```{python}
# | eval: true
# | label: fit-models

fitted_models = []
for sim in simulated_processes:
    sim = sim[sim["age"].notnull()]
    if len(sim) > 0:
        ages = sim["age"].values
        observation_time = time_span
        # If you want to use counts, you could add: counts = sim.get("count", None)
        model = fit_birth_death_process(
            ages=ages,
            observation_time=observation_time,
            counts=None,  # or provide counts if available
            method="L-BFGS-B",
            initial_params=None,
        )
        fitted_models.append(model)
    else:
        fitted_models.append(None)
```

```{python}
# | label: summary-statistics

# Collect birth and death rates from fitted models
birth_rates = [m["birth_rate"] for m in fitted_models if m is not None]
death_rates = [m["death_rate"] for m in fitted_models if m is not None]

summary_stats = {
    "Parameter": ["Birth Rate", "Death Rate"],
    "Mean": [np.mean(birth_rates), np.mean(death_rates)],
    "Median": [np.median(birth_rates), np.median(death_rates)],
    "Std": [np.std(birth_rates), np.std(death_rates)],
    "Min": [np.min(birth_rates), np.min(death_rates)],
    "Max": [np.max(birth_rates), np.max(death_rates)],
    "25%": [np.percentile(birth_rates, 25), np.percentile(death_rates, 25)],
    "75%": [np.percentile(birth_rates, 75), np.percentile(death_rates, 75)],
}

stats_df = pd.DataFrame(summary_stats)
print(stats_df)
```

```{python}
# | label: plot-bd-inference

if len(birth_rates) > 1:
    birth_kde = gaussian_kde(birth_rates)
    x_birth = np.linspace(
        min(birth_rates), min([max(birth_rates), 10 * birth_rate]), 100
    )
    fig_birth = go.Figure()
    fig_birth.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=x_birth, y=birth_kde(x_birth), mode="lines", name="Birth Rate Density"
        )
    )
    # Add vertical line for true birth_rate
    fig_birth.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=[birth_rate, birth_rate],
            y=[0, max(birth_kde(x_birth))],
            mode="lines",
            name="True Birth Rate",
            line=dict(color="red", dash="dash"),
        )
    )
    fig_birth.update_layout(
        title="Density of Fitted Birth Rates",
        xaxis_title="Birth Rate",
        yaxis_title="Density",
    )
    fig_birth.show()
else:
    print("Not enough fitted models to plot birth rate density.")

if len(death_rates) > 1:
    death_kde = gaussian_kde(death_rates)
    x_death = np.linspace(
        min(death_rates), min([max(death_rates), 10 * death_rate]), 100
    )
    fig_death = go.Figure()
    fig_death.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=x_death, y=death_kde(x_death), mode="lines", name="Death Rate Density"
        )
    )
    # Add vertical line for true death_rate
    fig_death.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=[death_rate, death_rate],
            y=[0, max(death_kde(x_death))],
            mode="lines",
            name="True Death Rate",
            line=dict(color="red", dash="dash"),
        )
    )
    fig_death.update_layout(
        title="Density of Fitted Death Rates",
        xaxis_title="Death Rate",
        yaxis_title="Density",
    )
    fig_death.show()
else:
    print("Not enough fitted models to plot death rate density.")
```

```{python}
# | label: joint-density-plot

if len(birth_rates) > 1 and len(death_rates) > 1:
    xy = np.vstack([birth_rates, death_rates])
    kde = gaussian_kde(xy)
    x_grid = np.linspace(min(birth_rates), 10 * birth_rate, 100)
    y_grid = np.linspace(min(death_rates), 10 * death_rate, 100)
    X, Y = np.meshgrid(x_grid, y_grid)
    positions = np.vstack([X.ravel(), Y.ravel()])
    Z = kde(positions).reshape(X.shape)

    fig_joint = go.Figure(
        data=go.Contour(
            x=x_grid,
            y=y_grid,
            z=Z,
            colorscale="Viridis",
            contours=dict(showlabels=True),
            colorbar=dict(title="Density"),
        )
    )
    fig_joint.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=[birth_rate],
            y=[death_rate],
            mode="markers",
            marker=dict(color="red", size=12, symbol="diamond"),
            name="True Value",
        )
    )
    fig_joint.update_layout(
        title="2D Density of Fitted Birth and Death Rates",
        xaxis_title="Birth Rate",
        yaxis_title="Death Rate",
        showlegend=True,
    )
    fig_joint.show()
else:
    print("Not enough fitted models for joint density plot.")
```

```{python}
# | label: box-plots
import plotly.graph_objs as go

# Prepare data for box plot
box_data = [
    birth_rates,
    death_rates,
]

labels = ["Fitted Birth Rates", "Fitted Death Rates"]
true_values = [birth_rate, death_rate]
means = [np.mean(birth_rates), np.mean(death_rates)]
medians = [np.median(birth_rates), np.median(death_rates)]

fig_box = go.Figure()

for i, data in enumerate(box_data):
    fig_box.add_trace(
        go.Box(
            y=data,
            name=labels[i],
            boxmean=True,
            boxpoints="outliers",
            marker_color="lightblue",
        )
    )
    # Add true value
    fig_box.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=[labels[i]],
            y=[true_values[i]],
            mode="markers",
            marker=dict(color="red", size=12, symbol="diamond"),
            name=f"True {labels[i].split()[1]}",
            showlegend=(i == 0),
        )
    )
    # Add sample mean
    fig_box.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=[labels[i]],
            y=[means[i]],
            mode="markers",
            marker=dict(color="green", size=10, symbol="circle"),
            name=f"Mean {labels[i].split()[1]}",
            showlegend=(i == 0),
        )
    )
    # Add sample median
    fig_box.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=[labels[i]],
            y=[medians[i]],
            mode="markers",
            marker=dict(color="orange", size=10, symbol="square"),
            name=f"Median {labels[i].split()[1]}",
            showlegend=(i == 0),
        )
    )

fig_box.update_layout(
    title="Box Plot of Fitted Birth and Death Rates with True, Mean, and Median Values",
    yaxis_title="Rate",
    xaxis_title="Parameter",
    showlegend=True,
)
fig_box.show()
```
